item.summary: India, the world’s largest producer and exporter of coir, is rooted in tradition and driven by innovation. The coir sector is emerging as a vibrant, eco-friendly and sustainable driver of economic and social progress. It not only promotes the productive use of coconut husks but also generates livelihoods and supports the growth of rural and traditional communities. With its strong focus on…
item.title: India’s Coir Sector: Creating Livelihoods, Promoting Entrepreneurship and Driving Sustainable Growth
